title: oncostemum reticulatum
intro: Oncostemum reticulatum, commonly known as the Himalayan sage, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. This herb is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Oncostemum reticulatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in soothing various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic actions.
